# Azure OpenAI Embedder

Similar to the OpenAIEmbedder, the AzureOpenAIEmbedder class interfaces with the Azure API to create text embeddings. It requires an Azure endpoint and key, allowing users to leverage Azure's deployment for generating embeddings seamlessly.
